parentProvenance.sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
parentProvenance.prompt: Photoreal cinematic miniature world, tactile ivory origami paper boat with one crisp triangular sail and sharply folded hull, no writing on the paper. Warm amber practical light against deep petrol-blue shadows, natural film contrast, 35mm commercial cinematography. The same single small ivory paper boat is the only hero object. Extreme close-up at table level. A small ivory origami sailboat rests on a dark wooden desk beside one blank sheet of paper. A thin shimmering pool of water slowly spreads underneath the boat; the boat lifts gently and floats as the desk surface becomes a deep blue ocean. An impossible transformation shown with physically convincing water and crisp stable folds. Slow controlled camera push. Quiet amber light from the left. One uninterrupted five-second shot.

sourceBrief: Create one 18–21 second AutoPromote welcome film about an ordinary idea finding a world, surviving a threat and becoming a finished story. I provide no recorded footage. Use the private generated raw library, preserving generation provenance. Open with paper-awakens at source 2.5 for 2.5 seconds. Use ocean-environment ONLY source 0.4 duration 1.7 seconds; later footage is overexposed. Use storm-action for visibly breaking wave action, light-return source 2 for 3 seconds for the SAME boat in golden calm, then world-on-desk to reveal the miniature origin. End with actual Studio UI and identity. Withhold AutoPromote until the payoff. Use the original score and the available brief-no-footage narration as a voiceover cue near the Studio reveal, fitting its complete duration; do not cut off speech. At most eight asset requirements. Every reused asset must keep an exact libraryRef, match its type and have current story-specific acceptance criteria. The absence of a boat in the wave cutaway is intentional; do not claim it is physically inside that shot. Do not imply the private factory is public. Do not pad with random effects. Return only one 16:9 welcome_hero output.
intendedRole:
